text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was early in the morning, Bamboo Memory's
loud greeting could already be heard
coming from the gate.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
It's all thanks to getting plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I managed to wake up before my alarm today!
I already won my first match of the morning, so I'm in top form!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, starting today, I'm gonna give it everything I've got again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Bamboo Memory was able
to get plenty of proper rest.
